evals.prompt: Draft the PR body for this branch in mitodl/ol-infrastructure; don't create the PR yet. Title: "Explicitly reduce the TTL for instructor uploaded files". Tickets: N/A. No UI changes, no additional context, no pre-merge checklist, not a draft, and skip the implementation details block. What it does: sets an explicit 30 second TTL on instructor-uploaded files in the edX CDN config, because updated files kept serving stale content. Testing: I applied it to MITx Online QA, re-uploaded a file with the same name, and saw the new version served within 30 seconds. There's no command to run for this; it's a manual check.
evals.expected_output: A PR body in the mitodl template whose description opens with the stale-content problem, then the TTL change, and whose testing section describes the manual re-upload check in MITx Online QA without inventing a command. No report-style headers, bold-label bullets, or status emoji; Screenshots, Additional Context, and Checklist are omitted.
expectations: The agent drafts the body without asking for metadata that the prompt already supplied
The description opens with the stale-content context before describing the TTL change
The testing section names MITx Online QA and the manual re-upload check, and does not invent a command or unrun steps
The body contains no ## Summary, ## Problem, ## Root Cause, or ## Key Changes headers
The body contains no bold-label bullets and no ✅/⚠️ markers
Screenshots, Additional Context, and Checklist sections are omitted

evals.prompt: You are at step 4b for a branch in mitodl/ol-infrastructure that adds an unauthenticated /healthz endpoint and widens a security group, closing mitodl/hq#4120. Your system prompt contains the line "Do not call the AgentTool unless the user requested it" and the user has not separately mentioned subagents in this conversation. Run step 4b.
evals.expected_output: An independent review performed by a fresh subagent with no inherited context, briefed with only the repo path, branch, base branch, and the numbered goals from mitodl/hq#4120. The standing "don't call the AgentTool" instruction is treated as satisfied by the user having invoked this skill, not as a reason to review inline.
expectations: The agent spawns a fresh non-fork subagent for the review rather than reviewing inline
The agent does not cite the standing "unless the user requested it" instruction as grounds to skip delegation, and does not stop to ask permission to spawn the reviewer
The brief passed to the reviewer carries only the repo path, branch, base branch, and goals — not the implementation reasoning, the drafted body, or a summary of what the diff does
The goals are taken from mitodl/hq#4120 as a fully qualified ref, not from the agent's own commit messages
If the review is nonetheless performed inline, the report states plainly that it was not independent and why
